exact_prompt: Transparent targeted highlands principal-view correction atlas, exact 6 columns x 6 rows, views columns FRONT, TOP, RIGHT, LEFT, BOTTOM, REAR. Exact source rows: (1) snowy mountain peak; (2) long snowy mountain ridge; (3) straight snowy cliff wall; (4) L-shaped snowy cliff corner; (5) rocky snowy slope mound; (6) low scree rubble patch. Use the current source-plus-six contact for identity, palette and footprint. Render strict axis-aligned orthographic views. Only the flagged cells below are being corrected; other cells may be simple identity-consistent placeholders and will not be used. Row1 PEAK TOP: exact nadir camera looking straight down; centered summit/snow cap in the middle of the footprint, radial branching snow/rock ridges visible as a flat map-like overhead surface, no triangular vertical pyramid faces, no front/rear face, no perspective. Row2 RIDGE TOP: direct nadir plan, long connected ridge axis horizontally across cell, preserve the ordered summits, show elongated top facets and snow patches as plan shapes; no upright triangular mountain faces or side walls. Row3 STRAIGHT CLIFF WALL: FRONT and REAR must be single broad rectangular straight vertical cliff faces viewed exactly perpendicular, full long arm visible and no V, no two faces at once. BOTTOM is a narrow long rectangular underside/root strip matching the accepted TOP cap's depth and length, not an oversized or square footprint. Row4 L-CORNER CLIFF: keep accepted L-shaped TOP. RIGHT and REAR each show the appropriate long full-width joined wall arm broad face at the same Z height as accepted FRONT/LEFT, never a narrow isolated post. Row5 STONE SLOPE TOP: direct nadir view of a rough snow/stone slope surface, flattened overhead top facets following the source footprint, no visible upright triangular faces or side walls. Row6 SCREE FRONT and REAR: low irregular vertical rubble elevation profiles only, stones grounded along a thin baseline, visible rock height comparable to RIGHT/LEFT; no horizontal ground-plane or broad top pattern. Preserve brown stone, white snow patches and source silhouette. All principal directions perpendicular/straight down/up, never isometric or three-quarter. Center full silhouette, transparent margins, no labels, no border, no detached fragments.
